policy_note: The confirmatory evaluation read the raw test split once. Before the preregistration freeze, an aggregate support count over 2018-22 (1,586,040 rows; 164,272 positives) was taken to size the holdout; it did not identify holdout units, fit a model, or compute a holdout-specific statistic. All post-freeze diagnostics reused the saved prediction file; no new raw event label was read. `labels_read` records whether a step read raw event labels: the post-process flag is false because that step restored labels from the saved predictions instead of reading raw data. Reads that predate the freeze and the three earlier exploratory passes (G2, D2, B) are out of this log's scope and are disclosed in the manuscript; see `out_of_scope`. The post-freeze stability audit logs its own burned-retrospective 2018-22 read in `results/framework_pilot/stability/summary_decompose.json`. A blind/quick smoke run was aborted by a broken pipe before the confirmatory run and read no labels.
